editorial.text: There’s a fair bit of coverage of the CILIP campaign, although notably it is only the libraries-friendly Guardian that has covered it. Please sign the petition and tell your friends if you can. In other news, Somerset have announced what appear to be significant cuts, although wrapped up in the language of co-locations. We’ll see what transpires there. Anyway, it’s Christmas week. I wish you all a very good festive week and a few good days of frivolity away from the concerns of the sector. Here’s to 2016.

There’s a fair bit of coverage of the CILIP campaign, although notably it is only the libraries-friendly Guardian that has covered it. Please sign the petition and tell your friends if you can. In other news, Somerset have announced what appear to be significant cuts, although wrapped up in the language of co-locations. We’ll see what transpires there.

Anyway, it’s Christmas week. I wish you all a very good festive week and a few good days of frivolity away from the concerns of the sector. Here’s to 2016.
